ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an.
   B. Say Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

3. Which response best shows understanding of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an.
   B. Say Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Care for widows? (1 mark)
   A. Say Care for widows has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Care for widows to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Care for widows.
   D. Apply the teaching of Care for widows with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Funeral Rites? (1 mark)
   A. Say Funeral Rites has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Funeral Rites to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Funeral Rites.
   D. Apply the teaching of Funeral Rites with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Asbabu al- nuzuul? (1 mark)
   A. Use Asbabu al- nuzuul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Asbabu al- nuzuul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Asbabu al- nuzuul.
   D. Say Asbabu al- nuzuul has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Types of verses? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Types of verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Types of verses has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of verses.
   D. Use Types of verses to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Administration of Zakat? (1 mark)
   A. Say Administration of Zakat has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Administration of Zakat to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Administration of Zakat.
   D. Apply the teaching of Administration of Zakat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn.
   C. Use Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn has no place in daily life.

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

11. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.
   C. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Selected verses Surah al- Furqan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected verses Surah al- Furqan.
   D. Say Selected verses Surah al- Furqan has no place in daily life.

13. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

14. Which response best shows understanding of Types of Divorce? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of Divorce.
   B. Say Types of Divorce has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Types of Divorce to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Types of Divorce with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Prayers on special occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Say Prayers on special occasions has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Prayers on special occasions to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prayers on special occasions.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Asbabu al- nuzuul and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Selected verses Surah al- Furqan and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Hadith and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Prayers on special occasions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Funeral Rites and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Administration of Zakat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Divorce and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
